title: DecAI Fit Scoring Input
description: Verified binary flag set derived from a project card during assessment; input format of the DecAI Fit reference scorer. Companion to the project-card schema (https://decaihub.io/schema/project-card/v1.0.0).

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the project card this flag set was derived from.

flags.description: Binary evidence flags. Every flag set to 1 must carry a recorded justification (source link + short fact) in the card's evidence entries.

AI_0.description: Tier-1 declaration of AI intent (roadmap/official update) without protocol-level AI evidence.

AI_1.description: What exactly the AI does is described.

AI_3.description: Quantitative metrics / benchmarks / quality assessments exist (see operational definition).

AI_4.description: Technical description / architecture / model versions exist.

OC_2.description: Onchain carries useful logic beyond the token (access/accounting/rules/DAO).

OC_3.description: Onchain is critical: replace-the-chain test breaks the product.

TK_4.description: Token is replaceable (USDC/subscription would work) — subtracts from the token score.

E_AI_T1.description: Tier-1 evidence exists for the AI block.

E_OC_T1.description: Tier-1 evidence exists for the onchain block.

E_TK_T1.description: Tier-1 evidence exists for the token block.

last_verified_days.description: Days since the card was last verified. Values above 550 trigger the staleness penalty.
